gen-zen-dots-gf-assistant: Friendly tech look, with generous space around every letter. Zen Dots keeps its openings wide at every weight, and Assistant carries that openness into body text with contemporary, no-fuss letters.
gen-zen-dots-gf-bpmf-huninn: Friendly tech meets bent plastic tubing. Zen Dots gives its letters ample room at every weight, while Bpmf Huninn draws a single-weight outline with a wide channel into every bowl.
gen-zen-dots-gf-bpmf-zihi-kai-std: Zen Dots wraps every letter in generous room. Bpmf Zihi Kai Std keeps its counters open to the outside and swells only slightly in curves, so extended text moves along gently.
gen-dafont-amadeus-gf-epunda-slab: Commanding and stretched wide, Amadeus fills the line. Amadeus is best at stretching out wide with pipe-like strokes, while the serif Epunda Slab is best at dignified, rounded lowercase.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-marcellus-sc: Marcellus SC reads dignified and literary, with gently modulated strokes. Capture It is best at towering, thick-threaded urban punch, whereas the lowercase here earns its keep through quiet cast-iron stature.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-marcellus-s: Raw and tactical, with big-bodied lowercase. Capture Smallz hits with blunt, low-variation strokes, and Marcellus SC sits against it in a dignified, literary register with gentle modulation throughout.
gen-dafont-college-gf-esteban: College arrives with curves that match its stems, big counters, and a tall lowercase that feels dynamic and authoritative. Esteban adds refined stroke contrast and an e that never squeezes shut.
gen-dafont-early-gameboy-gf-faustina: Faustina speaks with quiet authority. Early GameBoy stretches playfully wide across the top, while Faustina's open-jawed c and gracefully thinning bowls carry paragraphs along at a classic, authoritative pace.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-ovo: Cosmic and marker-drawn, with room to drift. Galaxy draws a constant marker line with loose letterfit, and Ovo steadies the page beneath with modest contrast and a tall middle band.
gen-dafont-good-times-gf-halant: Good Times is geometric and cable-thick, with an open e. Halant's faint thick-thin shift and towering x-height let the serif text drop a size or two without losing its traditional, authoritative feel.
